If you can sign in to your Mozilla account, you can change your password by following these simple steps:
#Go to [https://accounts.firefox.com/signin Mozilla account Sign in].
#;[[Image:Sign in MA|width=350]]
#Sign in with your current password.
#In the ''Security'' section, next to ''Password'', click {button Change}.
#;[[Image:CHANGE PASSWORD]]
#Enter your old password, then your new password.
#Click {button Save} to complete the change.
#;[[Image:SAVE button|width=350]]
